motion.name: power-on
motion.value: 900ms linear, once; opacity 0.18 at 0/8/20/34%, 1 at 4/14/26%, 0.55 at 40%, 1 from 46%
motion.purpose: Rows and plates lighting the first time they scroll in (rootMargin -12% bottom).

motion.name: glitch-slice
motion.purpose: Hero name magenta/cyan slices on a user lightning strike.

motion.name: neon-failure
motion.value: every 4-15s: stutter 45% (0.25-0.7s, flicker 1/0.12), dropout 30% (70-210ms at 0.06), brownout 25% (0.4-1.2s at 0.48 ±0.05 at 60Hz)
motion.purpose: Canvas sign idle failures; unselected signs rest at 0.6, selected at 1 with a 3.2s scan band.

motion.name: rain-diagonal
motion.value: dx = 0.27 * dy; 3 depth passes at 0.28/0.38/0.5 alpha; density levels 0.32/0.62/1
motion.purpose: Hero rain; the rain veil repeats the slant at rgba(185,169,214,0.13).

motion.name: camera-drift
motion.value: ease 1 - exp(-2.6 dt); idle after 4s: x = sin(0.11t) * 0.55, y = sin(0.07t + 1) * 0.25

motion.name: lightning-envelope
motion.value: pulses 1.0@0, 0.55@70ms, 0.85@200ms, each exp decay tau 65ms; bolt visible 340ms; ambient 0.35 exp(-t/0.12) + 0.2 echo at 160ms
motion.purpose: User and ambient strikes lighting sky, skyline and street.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: signs steady; parallax 35% at ease 1.5/s, no idle drift; rain 30% density, 55% speed; no ambient strikes; strike = single 0.45 flash (tau 350ms), no bolt, no glitch; ripple 1.5px; walkers/steam halved; rain veil not drawn; power-on/glitch/board-blink animation none; ticker 600s; scroll-behavior auto

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Alley After Last Train"**

The whole site is one wet Seoul side street at 1 a.m. The first viewport is a procedural canvas: violet skyline, near towers hung with vertical hangul neon signs (one per featured project), orange pojangmacha tents with walkers and steam, an OPEN sign with a dead N, a rippled reflection on the asphalt, diagonal rain and lightning on demand. Everything below the street is the same street walked on foot: every project as a lit sign row, experience as a dated shift log, the stack, and a last-train departure board. Copy sits on near-black ink so the neon is the only light; the light source is always the line's own colour.

Density is generous on the street and tight in the HUD. Display type is condensed uppercase Archivo pushed to 62% width with a magenta/cyan chromatic split; system chrome is ui-monospace in small tracked caps between corner brackets. Corners are square everywhere. Depth comes from glow and from the reflection, never from lifted cards.

Motion is the world's weather, not decoration: neon fails like old glass, rain falls on one diagonal, the camera drifts with the pointer, rows power on once with a stutter. Everything else stays still, and every one of those motions has an implemented reduced-motion fallback.
keyCharacteristics: Ink-black ground (#05010f) with three neon lines: magenta for applied AI, cyan for product work, acid yellow for the playground.
Condensed uppercase Archivo display with chromatic aberration; Gothic A1 Heavy for hangul sign lettering.
Monospace HUD voice in tracked caps, framed by 10px corner brackets.
Square geometry; light, not shadow, carries depth.
A single rain diagonal (dx = 0.27 · dy) shared by the hero scene and the rain veil below it.

rules.name: The Line Owns Its Light Rule
rules.body: Each body of work has exactly one neon colour (AI magenta, product cyan, playground acid). Every surface that belongs to a project (sign, tube title, code, divider, stack ticks, link underline, panel top edge) takes that line's colour and nothing else.

rules.name: The Only Light Rule
rules.body: Grounds are ink; colour appears only as emitted light (glow, tube text, hairline, pip). No neon-tinted panel fills except the three solid-fill devices: the solid tube button, the NOW badge, the NEWSWIRE label.

rules.name: The Tent Stays In The Street Rule
rules.body: Tent orange belongs to the canvas world. It never becomes a fourth line or a UI accent.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Condensed caps for anything that is a sign; tracked monospace caps for anything that is instrumentation. Body Archivo carries reading only. No third display voice.

rules.name: The Chroma Is For Headlines Rule
rules.body: The magenta/cyan split (±0.045em, `.chroma`) sits on white display and headline type; `.chroma-sm` (±1.5px) only on the JG mark. Line-coloured titles glow as tubes instead and never get chroma.

rules.name: The Rails Not Cards Rule
rules.body: Lists are rows on hairlines with a monospace rail on the left. No card grids.

rules.name: The Emitted Not Cast Rule
rules.body: Every shadow is light leaving a tube in its own colour. A dark offset shadow has no source on this street.

dos: Do give every project surface its line's single neon colour: magenta AI, cyan product, acid playground.
Do set signs, names and titles in condensed uppercase Archivo (62% width, 800, 0.88 line-height), and hangul sign lettering in Gothic A1 Heavy.
Do put all instrumentation in the 0.6875rem monospace label voice with 0.14em tracking and tabular numerals.
Do draw frames with 1px inset rings, 10px corner brackets and wire hairlines; keep every corner square.
Do express depth as emitted glow in the element's own colour, on ink grounds.
Do keep the rain on the 0.27 diagonal everywhere it appears.
Do ship a reduced-motion branch for every new moving thing, and pause canvases off screen and in hidden tabs.
donts: Don't add rounded corners, opaque filled cards or card grids, or dark offset drop shadows; panels are translucent ink with drawn frames.
Don't use tent orange or any fourth accent on UI chrome or text.
Don't put chroma on line-coloured tube titles or on body text.
Don't add motion outside the grammar (no scroll-triggered slides, fades or parallax on content); rows only power on.
Don't set hangul in the condensed Latin cut without its Korean tracking and line-height overrides.
